items.item: Notices the test has no assertions and rejects coverage-only testing
items.evidence: "It has no assertions. It would pass whatever `apply` did, so the 90% coverage only shows the lines ran."

items.item: Asks for asserts on the expected values, a bulk test and a negative case before approving
items.evidence: Suggests "assertions on the resulting discount values and a few cases for other account types and edge inputs such as an empty list and null fields." It does not clearly ask for a bulk test or a negative case.
